title: CAE and Black Eagle at MEBAA 2022
body_markdown:
CAE and Black Eagle have extended their training agreement for an additional year. Black Eagle pilots will train on the Bombardier Global Express and Challenger 604, as well as the Falcon 900EX at the Emirates Flight Training Centre (EFTC) in Dubai, CAE Burgess Hill in the United Kingdom, and CAE Dallas in the United States.


“We are grateful that Black Eagle continues to place their confidence in CAE to train their pilots,” said Nick Leontidis, CAE’s Group President, Civil Aviation. “Black Eagle can count on us to deliver the most advanced training and equip their pilots with the knowledge and skill to confidently fly customers around the world.”


Black Eagle is a business jet charter and aircraft sales company based in Istanbul, Turkey. They take a holistic and customer-centric approach to business aviation with a focus on every detail.
